recentItems.title: CICC nagulat sa Senate bill na ipagbawal ang social media sa under-18
recentItems.description:
Courtesy of DZMM



Bagamat sang-ayon siya sa panukala, nagulat si CICC Executive Director Renato Paraiso sa Senate Bill 2424 ni Sen. Robin Padilla na pagbawalan ang sinumang wala pang 18 taong gulang na gumamit ng social media o iba pang "high-risk digital services."

‘Nagulat kami sa age,” ani Paraiso, na sinabing wala silang panukala sa tamang edad na paggamit ng social media.

Aniya, ang mungkahi ng CICC ay magkaroon ng “heavy regulation” sa mga platforms, na magkaroon ang mga ito ng opisina at magkaroon ng mahigpit ng age verification process.

Tahimik naman si Paraiso sa balitang nagbitiw na si DICT chief Henry Aguda. Aniya, “hindi pa niya nararamdaman” ang balita at naghihintay pa ng huling abiso dahil hindi pa niya nakakausap ang kalihim.

Inabot ng matinding batikos si Aguda matapos ipagbawal ng DICT ang access sa Discord platform.

recentItems.title: Pope Leo says early-stage lung nodule detected, will undergo surgery
recentItems.description:
Pope Leo said on Sunday (October 11) that doctors had detected a small growth on his lung during a recent health check and he would be undergoing surgery this week to remove it, in the first health scare of the 71-year-old pontiff's tenure.

Leo told pilgrims in St. Peter's Square for his weekly Sunday prayer that the growth was "well-contained" and caught at an early stage.

"Recently, during some medical examinations, doctors found a localized nodule in my lung," said the pontiff. "It was detected at a very early stage and is well contained."

"The doctors believe it is advisable to intervene, so, following their advice, I have decided to undergo surgery to remove it," he said. "The operation is already scheduled for the next few days."

Leo, elected pope by the world's cardinals in May 2025, is relatively young for a Church leader. He enjoys sports, including tennis, and is not known to previously have had health issues.

The late Pope Francis, Leo's predecessor, died at age 88 and was increasingly frail in his later years.

The Vatican press office said Leo's recovery from surgery was expected to take about a week. It did not immediately provide further details about the pope's health.

recentItems.title: Impeach prosecutor 'overwhelmed' by prosecution's final witness | ABS-CBN News
recentItems.description:
Courtesy of DZMM





Impeachment lead prosecutor Gerville Luistro on Sunday said she was overwhelmed by the testimony of the prosecution’s final witness, forensic financial analyst Alex Cabrera, who flagged ₱817.87 million in allegedly undeclared assets and income involving the Vice President and her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio.

Luistro said Cabrera’s findings back Article II of the impeachment accusing Duterte of non-disclosures of unexplained wealth in her SALNs, non-divestment of other business interests and exercise of profession, business and conflict of interest.

“Kahit ako na overwhelm ng informations na shinare niya from his own forensic and financial report,” she told DZMM.

“Nabanggit lahat ‘yan. The least that we can do - ibangga mo ‘yung allegations dun sa findings niya during the direct and we are positive that he is satisfying or he is establishing the requirements of the allegations of Article II of the impeachment.”

Luistro noted the prosecution is unfazed that the defense will have at least 3 weeks to prepare its own presentation. 

She added there is also a possibility that senator-judges may summon other witnesses to the trial including security officers of VP Duterte.

recentItems.title: Ex-kapitan sa Tanauan City, patay sa ambush | ABS-CBN News
recentItems.description:
Patay ang isang 66-anyos na dating barangay chairman matapos pagbabarilin ng riding-in-tandem sa Barangay Talaga, Tanauan City, Batangas nitong Biyernes.  

Kinilala ang biktima na si Emeterio Awitan, dating kapitan ng Barangay Bañadero. 

Sa kuha ng CCTV, makikitang binuntutan ng mga suspek ang biktima habang sakay ng kanyang motorsiklo patungong city proper, bagamat hindi na nahagip ng camera ang mismong pananambang.

Batay sa imbestigasyon ng pulisya, .45 kalibre na baril ang ginamit sa krimen. Sa ngayon, kasama sa mga motibong sinusuri ng mga awtoridad ang nakaraang alitan nito sa isang empleyado ng gobyerno.

-Ulat ni Dennis Datu, ABS-CBN News

recentItems.title: Marcos, tinanggap na ang resignation ni DICT Chief Henry Aguda
recentItems.description:
Kinumpirma ni Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr. na tinanggap na niya ang pagbibitiw sa puwesto ni DICT Secretary Henry Aguda, na una nang nasangkot sa isyu ng connectivity projects.

Nilinaw din ng Pangulo na sa ngayon ay walang katotohanan ang mga bali-balitang babalik si DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon sa Department of Transportation (DOTr).

Samantala, papalitan na ni PTV4 General Manager Lino Cayetano si Dave Gomez  bilang kalihim ng Presidential Communications Office Secretary. 

Ayon sa pangulo, ito’y dahil na bypass si Gomez ng Commission on Appointments. 

Inihayag ito ng Pangulo sa isang media interview sa huling araw ng kanyang limang araw na working visit sa Singapore.
